lines.say: Gol gappay! But number three is way too spicy!
lines.cap: Gol gappay! But number 3 is WAY too spicy!

lines.say: So you stop, right there! In Python, that's break!
lines.cap: So you stop, right there! In Python, that's break!

lines.say: Break exits the loop instantly. No more gol gappay!
lines.cap: break exits the loop instantly. No more gol gappay!

lines.say: But what if I just want to skip one?
lines.cap: But what if I just want to SKIP one?

lines.say: Use continue! It skips that round, and the loop keeps going!
lines.cap: Use continue! It skips that round, and the loop keeps going!

lines.say: Your turn! Pause, and predict! What prints?
lines.cap: Your turn! Pause and predict! What prints?

lines.say: Seven! One plus two plus four!
Yes! Continue skips three, but keeps going. Break would give three!
lines.cap: Yes! continue skips 3 but keeps going. break would give 3!
